text: MRI is covered when medically necessary. Certain MRI procedures require prior authorization before the service is performed.
A claim may be denied when required prior authorization was not obtained. Members or providers may contact support to review appeal options.
Diagnostic imaging benefits are subject to the member plan, deductible, coinsurance, network status, medical necessity, and authorization requirements.
Prior authorization requests are reviewed using clinical criteria. Authorization status can be pending, approved, denied, or expired.
